title: Why Secondhand Clothes Are Outgrowing New Ones
hook: Thrifting just became a 43 billion dollar habit.
closing: Data's whole wardrobe is secondhand. He calls it archival, and soon, so will everyone else.
question: Do you shop secondhand? Best find?

segments.say: Secondhand clothing grew about five times faster than regular clothing stores last year. People are choosing used over new.
More than half of Americans now shop secondhand, 58 percent. A year ago, it was a smaller crowd.
The U.S. secondhand market is projected to hit 74 billion dollars by 2029. That's a huge jump from today.
